'''Jerridan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Jerridan was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and resided on the ancestral Jedi [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order the following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Exploring the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] with fellow Padawans [[Mennaus]] and [[Avitla]] in hopes of passing their [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], the group was slowed when [[Flesh Raider]]s attacked and injured Jerridan. While he and Avitla sought to take revenge on the raiders for their attack, Mennaus stressed the Jedi philosophy warning against passion and aggression.<ref name="TOR" />
